source_sentence: The Hordaland Group is dominated by two thick claystone units separated by an Eocene sandstone unit named the Grid Formation. The claystones are occasionally sandy and silty. The lower claystone unit contains laminae and beds of limestone and dolomite. ...
note: Hordaland Group, printed 'Depth interval: 927 -1927 mRKB MD'.
